description: Réseau d'assainissement des eaux - Regard/chambre is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. Les regards, chambres de visite ont pour fonctions l'accès au réseau d'assainissement dans le cadre de contrôles et d'entretiens. De plus ils servent de point de raccordement des réseaux secondaire et primaire. Ces objets font également partie du produit "Cadastre du réseau d'assainissement des eaux". Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
